question: What is the minimum time limit the Commission must give an addressee to submit written observations on the preliminary findings?
gold_citation: The addressee shall send those observations within a time limit set by the Commission that shall be no less than 21 days.

question: Can an addressee access the Commission's file before the preliminary findings are notified?
gold_answer: No. Access to the file must not be granted before notification of the preliminary findings.
gold_citation: Access to file shall not be granted before the notification of the preliminary findings pursuant to Article 101(2) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.

gold_answer: No. Use for translation is permitted only with faculty approval, acknowledgement and citations.

question: A student cites AI use correctly but did not obtain faculty permission. Is that a violation?
gold_answer: Yes. By default, using AI without faculty permission violates the academic honor code.
gold_citation: By default, students will violate the academic honor code if they use AI without citation (as this constitutes plagiarism) or without faculty permission.
